result:
I'd make people feel safe enough to be honest with each other.

Not just "be nice" — I mean actually remove the fear that stops us from listening, admitting we’re wrong, asking for help, or showing vulnerability. 

If fear of judgment, rejection, or conflict was gone, everything else gets easier. We’d share resources more freely, collaborate instead of posture, admit mistakes before they become disasters, and treat each other like people with full stories instead of threats or props.

One change with that kind of ripple effect is probably the most world-changing one you can get.

What would you change if you had to pick just one?
